risks.risk: Moisture/rot or infestation (seller may be mistaken; pallets can look dry but still be damp inside or have pests).
risks.proof: A short video showing board ends/underside plus a moisture meter reading (or close-up evidence of no damp/dark patches) on camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used pallets that may be damp/unsuitable for premium reuse (worst case: treat as lower-grade and require sorting/cleaning).

risks.risk: Condition variability (broken slats/loose nails/warping reduces usable quantity).
risks.proof: Clip pulling out a sample (10–20 pallets) showing underside/deck boards and any damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed condition pallets (worst case: assume some are damaged and reduce resale value).

risks.risk: “Foreign” pallet type not confirmed from readable stamps.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of stamp text on at least 5 pallets (front + side) with readable full wording.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used wooden pallets (worst case: no premium for foreign type).

risks.risk: Weight/delivery quantity not verified (500 kg claim).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the certified scale display with date/time and the pallet load, plus a ticket/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price with worst-case uncertainty (treat as not guaranteed 500 kg).

risks.proof: Close-up photos of surfaces and board ends plus a wipe test on camera showing residue.
risks.if_unproven: Price as pallets requiring cleaning/sorting (worst case: lower buyer acceptance).

proof_requests: Scale proof: photo/video of the certified scale reading with date/time and weight ticket.
Moisture proof: moisture meter reading or underside/board-end close-ups showing no damp patches (video preferred).
Stamp/type proof: readable close-ups of pallet stamps/markings (front + side) for at least 5 pallets.
Condition sample: video pulling out a sample of pallets showing underside and any broken slats/nails.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only testimony and does not replace missing evidence. From the current photos, the pallet type/origin, cleanliness/dryness, and the 500 kg certified weight cannot be verified remotely, so pricing safely requires the specific proofs requested.
